description.en: The IP address of the node.
The access port number of the node.

description.zh: 实例节点所在的可用区ID。例如，上海可用区C为cn-shanghai-c。
description.en: The zone ID of the instance node. For example, the zone ID for Zone C in the China (Shanghai) region is cn-shanghai-c.

description.zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大不超过64个ASCII字符。
description.en: A unique token generated by the client to ensure the idempotence of the request. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

description.zh:
节点类型，可选值：

- WORKER：热节点
- WORKER_WARM：冷节点
description.en:
The node type. Valid values:

- WORKER: hot node
- WORKER_WARM: warm node.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun elasticsearch transfer-node --instance-id es-cn-nif1q9o8r00080000 --node-type WORKER --client-token 5A2CFF0E-5718-45B5-9D4D-70B3FF0000 --biz-body port=9200 host=192.168.xx.xx zoneId=cn-shanghai-c --api-version 2017-06-13 --region cn-hangzhou
